title: TNA SP 106/10: the codebreaker's two-figure nomenclator, c. 1623-24 (key sheet DECODE R725; worksheets R657)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE metadata for R657, R660, R664, R704, R720, R721 and the pointers; identified the seventh record as R722 and a key record R725 in the same run of shelfmarks. Downloaded all 28 images with the project cookie.

Read DECODE R725, 'The Alphabett of Single Letters' - the contemporary codebreaker's fair key: a 20-value letter alphabet, a list of single letters standing for whole words, and two nomenclator word-lists.

Identified from the key sheet's own note ('It seemes there are numbers of woordes expressed by this difference of - over the figures') that a bar and a dot over a two-figure group select two different word-lists.

Dated the group from the recovered nomenclature - Marques Inichiosa (the Marques de la Inojosa, ambassador in England 1623-24), Palatinato, Il Principe, C. Barberino, Papa, Nuncio, Imbassiatore di Venetia - against DECODE's date, which is only the volume span 1558/1625.

Surveyed all 22 ciphertext pages and found they use three different systems, not one: R657 (two-figure), R660/R664/R720 (three-figure), R704/R721/R722 (letter-plus-figure). DECODE groups R720 with R704; the figures show it belongs with R660/R664.
Web search for any modern edition of SP 106/10; the published SP 106 transcription site covers only volumes 1-4, and nothing else was found.
Entry split from sp106box10 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): system A, the key sheet R725 and the worksheets R657. R657 has not yet been worked against the key. No new attack.

outcome.method_basis: The codebreaker's key sheet R725 is transcribed in full and explains the system, but no text in this cipher has been deciphered here: R657's worksheets have not been worked against it and no intercept in this system is among the imaged records.
outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from sp106box10. The key's vocabulary (Marques Inichiosa, C. Barberino, Palatinato) dates the whole SP 106/10 file to 1623-24. Status in progress: R657 not yet attempted.
